title: A ten-hop descent theorem for cubic crossing matchings
claims: For every finite undirected cubic multigraph (loops counted twice, parallel incidences distinguished) and every strict vertex ordering, the nonbacktracking local exposure updates specified in proof.md, forward at radius 3, reverse at radius 3, then forward at radius 4, give a strict ordering whose maximum crossing matching over all prefixes is at most that of the original ordering. The keys have at most ten additional hops of dependence.

On the eight-vertex cube numbered in proof.md, after the same three completed-threshold updates, the initial cuts with masks 1, 3, 5, 7 have final masks 0, 0, 0, 39 and crossing-matching numbers 0, 0, 0, 3. The updated matching objective therefore fails submodularity.
